articleTitle: Skellam Rank: Fair Learning to Rank Algorithm Based on Poisson Process and Skellam Distribution for Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Recommender system is a widely adopted technology in a diversified class of product lines. Modern day recommender system approaches include matrix factorization, learning to rank and deep learning paradigms, etc. Unlike many other approaches, learning to rank builds recommendation results based on maximization of the probability of ranking orders. There are intrinsic issues related to recommender systems such as selection bias, exposure bias and popularity bias. In this paper, we propose a fair recommender system algorithm that uses Poisson process and Skellam distribution. We demonstrate in our experiments that our algorithm is competitive in accuracy metrics and far more superior than other modern algorithms in fairness metrics.

articleTitle: VulDet: Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection Based on Graph Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of blockchain, security issues caused by smart contract vulnerabilities are receiving increasingly widespread attention. Unfortunately, traditional smart contract vulnerability detection methods rely heavily on expert knowledge and elaborate rules, while neural network-based vulnerability detection methods have not yet achieved satisfactory accuracy either. In this paper, we propose a novel vulnerability detection method for smart contracts called VULDET. We first construct a contract graph based on the structure of the smart contract source code and combine security domain knowledge to attach additional features to nodes in the graph that are closely associated with vulnerabilities to highlight key nodes, and finally use graph attention networks for contract vulnerability detection. We apply VULDET to reentrancy vulnerability as well as timestamp dependency vulnerability detection and conduct extensive experiments, and the results show that our approach has significant advantages over existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blockchain in the Safe and Trusted Sharing of Government Data
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: To avoid the security vulnerabilities and privacy leakage risks in the process of government data sharing, a data sharing scheme for government data based on blockchain is proposed in this paper. As one of the basic protocols for the next generation of global credit authentication and value Internet, blockchain technology has been paid more and more attention. The blockchain is used to realize data tamper-proof, distributed storage, privacy protection, traceability, and access control. Data sharing and exchange agreements between government public services have adopted blockchain technology, providing identity authentication and message permission management. Using the blockchain to record the sharing behavior and provide traceability, the smart contract is used to share and manage the data and ensure the data’s consistency on-chain and off-chain. Due to shortcomings of government data sharing, the paper designs a data-sharing scheme and technical framework based on blockchain technology. From its perspective, it takes housing provident fund data sharing, for example, to establish a provident fund chain in the industry. This blockchain application scenario has been applied to the housing provident fund industry, forming a new model of industry data sharing.

articleTitle: The Traceability of Millet Based on Blockchain Smart Contracts in Agricultural Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: As global agricultural production and supply chains become increasingly complex, the demand for food safety and transparency is also growing. Agricultural traceability, as a process of tracing products from production to consumption, can help relevant departments locate the problematic links when agricultural products have issues. However, traditional agricultural traceability carries the risks of tampering with traceability data, as well as problems of information silos and opacity. Blockchain technology provides a reliable solution for agricultural traceability, ensuring data security and transparency, while also improving the efficiency and accuracy of traceability. This paper proposes a method based on blockchain smart contracts for millet information traceability. The method includes the architecture and algorithms of millet traceability based on blockchain smart contracts, as well as the interaction and process between the main participants and the smart contract. In addition, we conducted a performance evaluation of the designed smart contract.

articleTitle: Image Blind Deblurring using Luminance Minimization Prior
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: We propose a novel image prior for image blind deblurring. Observing that the luminance component of YUV colour space has very low intensity value in the clear images. Based on this properties, we propose a novel luminance minimization prior for blind image deblurring. In particular, a L0-regularized term is applied to enforce the sparsity of the luminance component. Then an efficient algorithm is presented for solving the proposed formulation, which obtains the clear image. To validate the proposed approach, we conduct extensive experiments on deblurring images. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed method for image blind deblurring.

articleTitle: Research on MNIST Handwritten Number Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: The application of handwritten numeral recognition has great practical significance in daily life, so confusing numbers, difficult-to-recognize labels, and low recognition accuracy are issues that need to be optimized today. Problems with overly complex and inaccurate algorithm schemes for handwritten numeral recognition exist. Based on traditional convolutional neural networks, this paper proposes using a two-layer convolutional layer for feature extraction and then using a two-layer fully connected layer for feature smoothing to optimize handwritten numeral recognition. In the first layer, keep is used_prob performs an overfitting operation, utilizing the softmax cross entropy function in the second layer to maintain the accuracy of the model output while reducing function loss. At the same time, it realizes the visualization of handwritten digits in the TensorFlow environment. Finally, based on Adam optimizer, the results of three different optimization algorithms are compared under different learning rates. A perturbation model is added to the system to verify the experimental results. The optimization algorithm and learning rate conditions with the highest recognition rate are obtained. Their relatively good detection accuracy proves the effectiveness of this structure, which improves the accuracy while simplifying the model.

articleTitle: Construction of Eco-Sphere of Construction Enterprises under the Background of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In a multi-network environment, the application of big data and artificial intelligence to construction enterprises is conducive to ensuring quality and efficiency. At present, new technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain are in the ascendant, and the integration and superposition of many new technologies are promoting the continuous deepening of the industrial revolution and accelerating the pace of digital transformation of construction enterprises. But at present, there are some problems in construction enterprises, such as the lack of fine management, the lack of timely and accurate access to information, the backward operation and production technology. In this paper, taking CCCCLTD as an example, in the era of the digital economy, how to adapt the construction industry to the development of the digital era, through the ąřEnterprise portaląś to establish a highly efficient and coordinated enterprise eco-circle, to achieve industrial upgrading and core value reconstruction, for reference of similar construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Fast Multivariate Search for Unequal-Length Fed-Batch Fermentation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: A huge amount of high-frequency on-line data are accumulated in the industrial fermentation. These data are used to evaluate the fermentation status through batch similarity search. For the fed-batch fermentation, the fermentation time varies between different batches. Meanwhile, multiple process variables are utilized for the similarity search, such as temperature, pH, aeration rate, etc. Therefore, the multivariate time series search problem should be solved for these unequal-length fermentation batches. In this study, a framework is proposed to reduce the frequency of computationally expensive distance calculations between multivariate time series pairs. The validation result indicates that the proposed method significantly reduces the similarity search time, at the cost of an acceptable loss of accuracy. Therefore, it is feasible for the multivariate search of unequal-length fed-batch fermentation.

articleTitle: Environmental Sound Classification Using CNN Based on Mel-spectogram
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of deep learning technology, the combination of deep neural network and audio data processing and analysis has become a new research hotspot, especially the representative convolutional neural network has achieved significant results on sound classification tasks. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a CNN structure, combined with extracting Mel-spectogram features and using data enhancement to increase the training data, and finally compare the classification accuracy under different CNN networks, and the experiments show that the method in this paper has a higher accuracy.

articleTitle: A Case Study to Evaluate the Diffusion of Technological Traceability Systems: Exploratory Insights from South Italy Agri-food Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Connectivity and technological evolution provide growth opportunities for companies in terms of improving processes controls, food safety and quality. Although technologies application is widely debated in the international research panorama, the agri-food companies’ awareness in traceability technologies is not always well developed, leading to a low level of diffusion. This study focusing on evaluating the diffusion of technological traceability systems based on sensing technologies, smart labels, and blockchain and the propensity to use blockchain technology of agri-food companies. For this purpose, a case study was realized involving ten agri-food companies in the south Italy which were interviewed through an ad-hoc designed questionnaire. The performed analysis allowed to supply an exploratory picture of the current diffusion level of technological traceability systems in the micro companies of south Italy. The results show that there is little investment in traceability technologies in the companies surveyed, with only a few types of tracking technologies already adopted (Barcode and GFN). In contrast, the use of smart labels is completely absent, although knowledge of elements that could enable their development (such as blockchain technology) is partly well-established. Companies claim to be interested in their use, since them represents suitable vehicles for fulfilling market needs and, are willing to invest a reasonable amount of money in such technologies. This study allowed to validate the analysis tools, paving the way for the follow-up of the analysis on a national scale.

articleTitle: Improve the level of governance system and accelerate the implementation of strategic transformation - Application analysis of blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Chinese economy, China’s digital economy has entered the fast lane. We need to promote the deep integration of digital and real economies. The integrated application of blockchain technology is essential in new technological innovation and industrial change. Blockchain technology is developing rapidly in our country and profoundly integrating with many industries. It promotes trust between upstream and downstream sectors, enables efficient data sharing, and enhances risk prevention capabilities. Therefore, by analyzing the strategic requirements of “Five businesses of China Communications Construction Co., Ltd. “ and the governance system of building a “living community,” this paper explores blockchain technology’s essence and application scenarios. It proposes to build a governance system and implementation path of “trust the Internet” with the help of the application of blockchain technology in China Communications Construction Co., Ltd. Group to improve the overall governance level. Finally, we conducted a risk analysis of the CCCC governance system based on blockchain technology to ensure the smooth implementation of the scheme.

articleTitle: Reducing Service Response Time Using Genetic Algorithm in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: The emergence of mobile edge computing (MEC) can greatly reduce the service invocation response time of edge users. Because the location of users in MEC is dynamic and the geographical location is constantly changing, and the rate of data transmission is closely related to the movement of edge users, which will affect the response time of service calls. To deal with this challenge, this paper proposes a service selection algorithm based on genetic algorithm, which can minimize the total service response time of edge user services. In the experiments, the method adopted in this paper can effectively reduce the service response time.

articleTitle: Research on a Multifunctional Vehicle Safety Assistant System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: At present, vehicle safety accidents occur frequently, multi-model intelligent driver assistance system is not perfect, most of the vehicle drivers can not effectively prevent the coming danger, related to the study of vehicle safety driver assistance technology is increasingly paid attention to. This paper mainly introduces a multi-functional vehicle safety assistance system based on artificial intelligence. Facing various road conditions and driving environments, the system adopts artificial intelligence embedded learning system and machine vision image detection technology of deep learning to realize real-time monitoring of road conditions in front of the car. Especially sudden driving obstacles such as pedestrians, cars, animals, etc., assist the car driving system for intelligent emergency braking or obstacle avoidance, so as to effectively improve the safety and intelligence of car driving, greatly reduce the incidence of accidents.

articleTitle: An Optimized Snapshot Raft Algorithm for Log Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Consensus algorithm is widely used in distributed system, which can solve the problems of fault tolerance and data consistency. Raft algorithm is one of the most widely used consensus algorithms to maintain consensus and fault tolerance in some distributed systems. However, the original Raft algorithm may fail to consider the problems of recovering the logs of all servers from failures as well as the increase number of logs under failures such as node downtime and unreliable networks. To this end, we propose an optimized Raft algorithm based on Snapshot technology, called Snapshot Raft (SS-Raft). Snapshot is one of the methods of log compression. When consensus is reached, the SS-Raft algorithm can exploit the snapshot technique to compress the number of entries submitted to the log. The experimental results illustrate that the number of log entries submitted by the server decrease significantly under unreliable network and churn failures, which will effectively reduce the storage space of nodes and greatly improve the system performance. In addition, the SS-Raft algorithm can also operate normally under a variety of failure environments and improve the performance of distributed systems.

articleTitle: Research on Endoscopic Image Depth Estimation Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Depth estimation of endoscopic images has always been a hot and difficult problem in minimally invasive surgery. Accurately estimating the depth information of endoscopic images can help surgeons improve the efficiency of surgical operations. This paper proposes a depth estimation method for endoscopic images based on deep learning, the ResNet34 module, FPN module and position information enhancement module are introduced to extract features. The reprojection loss, structural similarity index and edge-aware smoothing loss are used as loss function to improve the accuracy of depth prediction model and improve the applicability of the proposed method. The evaluation experiment uses the endoscopic image dataset, and the experimental results show that the depth information obtained by our method is more accurate than other state-of-the-art methods, which further verifies the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research And Innovation Practice of Intelligent Operation System of Large-Scale Construction Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: In the current era of comprehensive integration and development of the Internet, big data and artificial intelligence, digitalization, science and technology, and intelligence have begun to have an impact on the construction field, and construction enterprises have gradually developed new operating systems, gradually promoting the reform of the construction industry in the environment of big data. In this paper, the intelligent operation system of large-scale construction enterprises is designed, and the intelligent operation system that connects the early design, engineering management, production management and operation decision-making is built by relying on the information platform built by cloud services, and according to the building The coupling degree of enterprise business designes six business clouds: control cloud, capital cloud, engineering cloud, production cloud, marketing cloud, and resource cloud. Taking CCCC as an example, the practical results of building a smart operation system were introduced, hoping to provide favorable reference for the development of construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Big Data Mining Algorithm of Internet of Things Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: This paper focuses on how to improve the processing efficiency, mining efficiency, and result accuracy of IoT big data mining algorithms to meet the growing data volume and complexity through optimal design based on artificial intelligence techniques. We propose methods to build data model trees, detect IoT feature data, and standardize feature data to optimize the performance of traditional algorithms in the face of uneven data distribution, high feature dimensionality, noise and missing values. The simulation experiment results show that the IoT big data mining algorithm based on AI technology can better handle massive data, discover patterns and laws in data, improve the accuracy and efficiency of data mining, and provide more accurate and reliable information and knowledge for IoT decision making and management. It helps to promote the digital transformation and intelligent development of various industries and realize the optimization and upgrading of IoT systems.

articleTitle: A Carbon Emissions Verification Mechanism Based on Blockchain and Reverse Auction
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: With the establishment of the Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality targets, Carbon Emissions Trading(CET), as an important emissions reduction policy tool, needs to be supported by more accurate carbon emissions data. However, the problems of low credibility of data and mismatch between government budget and work requirements are existing in the current carbon emissions data verification business. In this paper, we proposed a blockchain-based carbon verification mechanism to address the problem of low credibility of carbon emissions data, and realized the full traceability of verification data through a data control model of "private chain + alliance chain". Then we designed a reverse auction algorithm based on ring signature to address the problem of mismatch between government budget and work requirements. We also use the alliance chain platform FISCO BCOS as the underlying architecture, designed the corresponding smart contract, and verify the feasibility of the system. The results are conducive to promoting the market-oriented and benign development of carbon verification business.

articleTitle: WPBFT:An improved consensus algorithm based on the HotStuff algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the consensus algorithm that currently exists in blockchains, and then mainly discusses the PBFT consensus algorithm widely used in consortium chains and the improved HotStuff algorithm based on it. However, they also have some disadvantages, such as low throughput, especially when nodes continue to increase, throughput will decline rapidly. Although HotStuff has improved the masternode election mechanism, the signature encryption algorithm it uses is insecure and inefficient. Finally, based on these problems, we propose a consensus algorithm WPBFT based on HotStuff’s improvement. Our consensus algorithm is improved in the following ways. First, the new consensus mechanism will not need to elect a masternode, but will use random selection of masternodes, so we will change the time complexity of HotStuff from O(n) to O(1), greatly reducing network communication. Secondly, this paper adopts the Ed25519 encryption algorithm, and improves its foundation, introducing a large number compression algorithm, which effectively improves the security and encryption efficiency when the message type is relatively large. Finally, it adopts a chronologically-based chain structure at the nodes. Through experiments, we show that the proposed algorithm has been significantly improved compared with PBFT and HotStuff algorithms in terms of data throughput and communication delay.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Belt Wearing Detection Algorithm based on Artificial Intelligence Working at Altitude
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Under the call of the corresponding country, urban construction has been attached importance. The following is the safety of construction workers, safety helmet, safety belt, safety chain and other safety needs a new digital transformation. Given that there are few researches on high-altitude belt wear detection at present, this paper proposes an improved Yolov5 model cae pre-training Yolov5_MobileNetv3 detection algorithm based on self-supervised visual pre-training. Firstly, unmarked self-supervised pre-training cae model was used to learn the characterization ability of complex scenes in construction sites. Then, multi-layer feature distillation technology is used. Finally, for some small targets in dense scenes, Softnms algorithm is used to improve the detection ability of the model in complex environment for human body and seat belt, and enhance the generalization and robustness of the model. The experimental results show that compared with Yolov5_MobileNetv3 model, cae-pretrained Yolov5_MobileNetv3 model significantly improves the detection performance of human body, safety belt, safety hat and other human attributes. Based on its own data, the accuracy rate is 94.35%, recall rate is 92.92%, F1 value is 93.63%, which meets the requirements of belt wearing detection in construction scenarios.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Federated Random Forest Approach for Power-Related Data Collaborative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: As big data technology rapidly evolves in the power grid, various data-driven tasks have become an integral part of the emerging power information system. Data analytics has expanded from within the smart grid to collaborative analytics across industries. Many structured power-related data and machine learning analysis tasks are kept in the smart grid. However, most of the existing federated learning approaches focus on the deep learning domain, and less on the traditional machine learning domain, urgently needed for federated machine learning research. Besides, collaborative analytics are also undermined by the denial or tampering by unhonest participants. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based federated random forest algorithm that can be used for federated analysis of structured power-related data. Among them, we design a blockchain-oriented distributed federated random forest aggregation method to aggregate decision trees trained by different participants, building trust between participants through the tamper-evident nature of the blockchain. In addition, we propose a double-layer encryption mechanism to protect the confidentiality of the on-chain data. The reading and aggregation of these data is secured by smart contracts, so that even after the complete random forest is published, an attacker cannot determine which of the decision trees was trained by which user, protecting the data privacy of the participants. We validated the method on two real-world UCI datasets. Compared with random forest models, our method is able to achieve 90% of its accuracy. Experimental results indicate our method is effective.

articleTitle: A Novel Class-Specific Deep Convolutional Feature Selection Method for Image Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology (AIBT)
abstract: Image representation is a critical problem in computer vision, which can improve the result of image classification, object detection, visual tracking, and so on. The image feature can be divided into two categories, the handcrafted feature and the deep convolutional feature (DCF). Compared with the handcrafted feature, the DCF based on deep convolutional neural networks is more effective and efficient. Therefore, more and more researchers utilized DCF in various computer vision tasks. However, most existing works directly use or simply reduce the dimension of DCF, which may induce performance degradation in practical applications due to its high degree of redundancy. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel DCF selection method named class-specific deep convolutional feature selection (CS-DCFS) for effective image representation. As various classes are distinguished from others based on different feature subsets, the CS-DCFS selects a specific feature subset for each class from the DCF candidate set. A modified genetic algorithm that uses one of the two mutation operations is proposed to select the feature, two designed mutation operations can increase the generating speed of the population. Furthermore, class-separability is adopted to measure the selected feature subset, which is a powerful and effective measurement of feature discrimination. Experimental results have shown the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method on the image classification task in four challenging benchmark datasets.
